name: page-diff
description: How close two page-recordings of the same steps file are, state by state, and what differs: pixels, frames, computed styles, and animations. Cached by content.

verbs.name: compare
verbs.description: Compare recording b against recording a, such as a rebuild against the original. Prints one line per state with its score and pixel mismatch, then the overall score, or the diff with --json. Cached by the content of both recordings and the tolerance.

a.description: recording.json of the reference, such as the original component.

b.description: recording.json to judge against a, such as the rebuild, recorded with the same steps file.

tolerance.description: Largest per-channel difference, from 0 to 255, that still counts as the same pixel.
